trailhead.label: Chalet Spinale, at the top of the Spinale gondola, the APT’s start

cautions: High and open above 2,000 m, with no shelter on the way in bad weather.
Cattle on the Spinale pastures in summer.
Ski-area service tracks and lift stations along the way.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
